description: This file defines an abstract class for transforming obsolete HTML tags into valid tags within the HTMLPurifier library. It contains properties and methods related to tag transformation, including an abstract method for performing the transformation and a concrete method for prepending CSS styles to attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_TagTransform
classes.description: An abstract class representing a mutation of an obsolete HTML tag into a valid tag.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the transformation of an obsolete HTML tag into a valid one.

methods.name: prependCSS
methods.description: Prepends CSS properties to the style attribute of an element, creating the attribute if it doesn't exist.
